games.title: Bagong Taon
games.tagline: The classic maze-bomber, New Year's Eve style
games.description: Chase the malas out of every kanto with cartoon Bawang before midnight. Shoo them into kwitis, fill Lola's media noche table, beat the old wall calendar, and jump at 12:00. Two players can share one keyboard.

games.title: Habulan sa Palengke
games.tagline: The classic maze chase, Pinoy style
games.description: Eat all the pan de sal while four tsismosa titas chase you through the palengke, simbahan and mall. Grab Nanay's tsinelas and chase them back.

games.title: Bantay Kubo
games.description: Drive a jeepney tank, fire garlic, and guard the bahay kubo from duwende, tikbalang, aswang, kapre and manananggal across ten barangays, with a Kapreng Balete and a Bakunawa to beat.

games.title: Ahas sa Fiesta
games.tagline: Classic snake at a Pinoy fiesta
games.description: A flag-colored snake in a salakot eats street food on a woven banig and dodges the tinikling poles, through seven festival barangays.

games.title: Huling Byahe
games.tagline: The last jeepney of the night
games.description: Drive the last trip through Manila from 11 PM to 5 AM. Your passengers are ghosts, and each one has somewhere to be before sunrise.

games.title: Isang Tira
games.description: One Sungka turn a day, the same board for everyone. Match par in three tries, with Lola Iska watching. Monday is gentle; Sunday is a long sowing.
